identification: About 19 W.E. Johns (Capt. W.E. Johns) Biggles hardbacks, mostly Hodder & Stoughton / Brockhampton-era 1930s-1960s printings. Spines read: Biggles in the Baltic (buff cloth, no jacket), Biggles Hunts Big Game (red cloth), Biggles Delivers the Goods (pink-red cloth), Biggles Takes Charge (Hodder jacket), Biggles Air Commodore (buff, partial), then pictorially jacketed 1950s-60s copies with yellow Hodder shield labels: Air Detective, Pioneer Air Fighter, of the Special Air Police (jacket torn at top), Flies to Work, and the Cruise of the Condor, of 266, Flies Again, Investigates (large format 1960s jacket), Goes Alone, Sweeps the Desert, Of the Special Air Police (second copy), plus 'The Big...' title at front and a Biggles and the ... title. Several have price/library-style yellow labels on jackets. Edition years not visible. Armitage estimate 60-90, current bid $20.
